profile.headline: Senior .NET & Azure Engineer/Architect • Realtime & Device Control • Blazor/SignalR • Observability & Reliability • AZ-204 in progress • Remote
profile.summary:
I’m a senior software engineer/architect who builds reliable, human-friendly software on the Microsoft stack. Over 30 years, I’ve shipped web, Windows, and mobile systems; for the last 12+ I’ve been remote-first, leading delivery and mentoring teams across time zones.

What I’m best at

Designing and shipping .NET backends and Azure cloud services that are observability-first (structured logs, correlation IDs, health checks).

Building production front-ends in Blazor (and React/Angular/Svelte/Vue) that put UX and clarity first.

Realtime systems with SignalR and Windows services/agents—safe update flows, staged rollouts, and resilient comms.

Turning messy, high-risk projects into calm, predictable delivery with clean API design, tests where they matter, and good operator experience.

Notable work

Global museum CMS: Led the engineering of a content platform used across multiple branches—improved deployment reliability, in-app help, and diagnostics to cut support escalations and speed fixes.

Device Control Cloud: Architected a realtime orchestration layer for Windows agents (Worker Services + SignalR) with secure updates, health checks, and telemetry—reducing field interventions and enabling safer, staged rollouts.

BrightSign partner tooling: Asset mgmt, scheduling, remote control, and robust offline behavior for digital signage at scale.

Toolbox
.NET 8/9/10-preview · C# · ASP.NET (Web API/MVC) · EF Core · SQL Server · Azure App Service/SQL/Key Vault/Storage/Front Door · SignalR · CI/CD · Logging/Monitoring · OAuth/OpenID · Windows services · Telemetry/diagnostics · Performance & reliability · Mentoring

How I like to work

Pragmatic architecture (guardrails before gadgets), small batches, strong release hygiene.

Make problems visible (dashboards, alerts, snapshots) so teams move faster without breaking things.

Partner with product/ops early; document the “how to run it” path, not just the code.

Availability
Remote. Open to 24–32 hrs/week ongoing, or 1–3 month full-time sprints to accelerate a critical initiative or harden reliability. Comfortable with async collaboration and US time-zone overlap.

If you’re shipping on .NET/Azure and want fewer surprises and faster outcomes, let’s talk.

positions.description: Building a .NET 10-based Datacenter Accountability System for a government client requiring audit-conscious room entry/exit tracking, secure workflow design, and careful handling of badge-derived identifiers.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading modernization of the company CMS from ASP.NET WebForms on VB.NET 4.8 to a C# .NET 10 Blazor Server application.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description: Architect and lead engineer for a multi-site digital signage and content management platform used by branch museums globally.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.locationName: Oak Ridge, Tennessee, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Long-term consultant modernizing and supporting multiple federal and public-health systems (e.g., ChemPack, ELLCAS, BAWR, PECAT) built on ASP.NET / ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, SQL Server, and Windows/mobile apps under strict security and compliance requirements.
•	Architected and delivered C#/.NET web applications and RESTful APIs on IIS, implementing authN/authZ, validation, and structured logging that improved production support and audit traceability.
•	Optimized SQL Server workloads by redesigning schemas, indexes, and stored procedures; analyzed execution plans and resolved parameter sniffing and blocking, turning multi-minute operations into near real-time responses and stabilizing nightly processing.
•	Engineered Windows services and scheduled jobs for ETL, imports/exports, and external integrations with resilient error handling and restart logic, significantly reducing manual intervention by operations teams.
•	Led cross-layer incident resolution (app, DB, infrastructure), partnering with DBAs, sysadmins, and security to identify root causes, ship safe incremental fixes, and prevent recurrences.
•	Partnered with non-technical program staff to turn regulatory and business requirements into technical designs, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria; authored clear documentation for support and future development teams.
•	Provided informal technical leadership through code reviews, estimation, and sprint planning in hybrid Agile/Waterfall environments, helping the team deliver on fixed public-sector milestones without sacrificing quality.

•	Owned the full lifecycle from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, deployment, and long-term production support.
•	Delivered domain-specific solutions for construction and scientific applications across Windows and mobile platforms.
